turns.text: The build fails because the tsconfig targets ES2019 and the code uses top-level await.
Raising the target to ES2022 fixes the build but changes the emitted helpers.
The emitted helpers only matter if you still ship to Node 14, which the engines field rules out.
So the change is safe: raise target to ES2022 and drop the downlevel helpers.
One caveat -- the browser bundle inherits this target, so check the minimum browser you support.
